why: The only major reviewer is TechRadar, and its page is a deal post on a bundle with a 45W panel, so it doesn't answer the question. Volt & Valley comes closest: it pairs the Jackery 1000 v2 with 400W of panels, but only from specs and as a combo you put together, not a confirmed bundle. Powersized tracks kit prices, but the excerpt names no 1kWh + 400W kit. The other readable pages are listicles built around 200W panels, and five results have no text. A focused page listing the 1kWh + 400W bundles with current prices would stand out.
